claim: Kunsthistorisches Museum charges €22 online / €24 on-site for adults in 2026, opens Tue-Sun 10-18 with Thursday late opening until 21:00, and is free for under-19s.
quote: Open daily, 10 a.m. - 6 p.m. Thu until 9 pm ... Adults: €22 / €24 ... Reduced: €19 / €20 ... Children & teens under 19: Free

claim: Vermeer's 'The Art of Painting' (1666-68) is owned by the Austrian Republic and permanently displayed at the Kunsthistorisches Museum as one of its anchor masterpieces.
quote: The Art of Painting ... is owned by the Austrian Republic and is on display in the Kunsthistorisches Museum in Vienna.

claim: The KHM Kunstkammer holds around 2,200 Habsburg objects in gold, silver, ivory, gemstones and rare materials, anchored by Cellini's gold Saliera salt cellar.
quote: around 2,200 of these wonders are on display in the Kunstkammer ... At the heart of the collection is Benvenuto Cellini's precious salt cellar, the Saliera

claim: Locals favour KHM's Thursday late opening because crowds thin and the Bruegel room empties enough for unhurried viewing.
quote: locals value the Thursday late opening when crowds thin and the Bruegel room empties enough for contemplation

claim: Albertina charges €19.90 adult in 2026, opens daily 10-18 with extended hours until 21:00 on Wednesday and Friday, and offers a €5 smartphone audio guide.
quote: Daily | 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. Wednesday & Friday | 10 a.m. to 9 p.m. ... General admission: €19.90 ... Smartphone Guide ... €5.00

claim: Albertina's permanent 'Monet to Picasso' show pairs with up to five rotating temporaries; a Picasso-Bacon retrospective opens September 2026.
quote: MONET TO PICASSO

claim: The Leopold Museum opens Wed-Sun 10-18 with Thursday late opening until 21:00, and is closed Mondays and Tuesdays.
quote: Wednesday to Sunday from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m., with extended hours until 9 p.m. every Thursday

claim: Leopold Museum adult admission is €19 in 2026, with €16 reduced for under-26 and over-65 visitors.
quote: Tickets cost €19 for adults. Reduced tickets (under 26, over 65) are €16.

claim: The Leopold houses the Schiele collection Rudolf and Elisabeth Leopold assembled over 50 years, plus Klimt, Kokoschka and a Vienna Modernism permanent display.
quote: synonymous with the name of Egon Schiele ... assembled by Rudolf and Elisabeth Leopold over 50 years ... numerous works by Schiele, Klimt, Kokoschka

claim: Visitors call the Leopold 'a museum of exceptional quality' and note its Vienna 1900 floor showing Klimt's 'Death and Life' and 'Am Attersee' alongside Wiener Werkstätte objects.
quote: Klimt's work up to his remarkable "Death and Life" and "Am Attersee", as well as selections from the Wiener Werkstätte

claim: The Freud Museum occupies his actual 1891-1938 apartment and surgery at Berggasse 19, recently reopened after renovation; AR reconstructs his missing couch.
quote: Freud's former apartment and surgery (1891-1938) ... An augmented reality experience of his missing famous couch

claim: Reviewers concede the Freud Museum has few original Freud objects left but call it worthwhile for its psychological-history atmosphere rather than spectacle.
quote: doesn't have as many preserved items from Sigmund and Anna Freud's original apartment, but it's definitely worth a visit

claim: MAK permanently displays Klimt's nine surviving full-scale Stoclet Frieze cartoons within its Vienna 1900 galleries after multi-year restoration.
quote: gilded design of Gustav Klimt for the frieze of the Stoclet Palais ... the existing nine parts of the illustrations

claim: MAK is housed in an 1871 Heinrich von Ferstel neo-Renaissance building and covers applied arts from Baroque and Biedermeier to Wiener Werkstätte and the iconic Thonet No. 14 chair.
quote: designed by Heinrich von Ferstel and opened in 1871 ... Baroque, Rococo, Biedermeier, Art Nouveau, and Vienna 1900 ... Thonet Model No. 14 chair

claim: Weltmuseum Wien sits inside the Hofburg and holds Habsburg ethnographic treasures including Montezuma's quetzal-feather headdress (Penacho) and James Cook voyage objects.
quote: the unique Mexican feather headdress »Penacho«, the world-famous collection of James Cook

claim: Reviewers credit the Weltmuseum with engaging colonial-history framing and recommend 3-4 hours to cover its 14 themed galleries plus the medieval armoury and ancient-instruments collection upstairs.
quote: plan to spend at least 3-4h there. Your ticket includes access to three exhibits: the ethnographic collection on the first floor, plus the impressive medieval armor and Museum of Ancient Instruments

claim: The MuseumsQuartier is a 90,000 m² complex of 60+ institutions including Leopold, mumok and Kunsthalle Wien, with the Leopold the strongest single-museum pick for short visits.
quote: Leopold Museum appears the strongest option for limited time ... dual focus—the major Schiele holdings plus Wiener Moderne era coverage

claim: The MQ's outdoor courtyards with iconic colourful 'Enzi' furniture function as free public space; the MQ Libelle rooftop on the Leopold offers free Vienna views from March to October.
quote: MQ Libelle rooftop terrace of the Leopold Museum is accessible free of charge from March to October ... famous colourful MQ furniture

claim: Wien Museum on Karlsplatz reopened December 2023 after a four-year rebuild that nearly doubled usable space, with free permanent collection access — a first for Vienna.
quote: permanent exhibition that is accessible to everyone free of charge, marking a first for Vienna ... net usable space has almost doubled

claim: For visitors prioritising Klimt's 'The Kiss', the Belvedere — not KHM or Leopold — is the required stop, holding the world's largest Klimt collection of 24 paintings.
quote: largest and most significant collection of Klimt paintings in the world with 24 paintings ... Upper Belvedere should be your top priority
